name: setu-ts-website
description: Public website for Setu-TS. A standalone pnpm project outside the repository workspace, never in a published package's dependency graph.

scripts.build: cd .. && node scripts/generate-api-docs.ts && cd website && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/graft.mjs && pagefind --site dist && node scripts/check-links.mjs
